facts.program: Home Renovation Savings heat pump rules
facts.claim: Rented heat pumps qualify: $500/ton up to $2,000 (air source) or $3,000 (ground source) for any primary heat source. Pre-approval mandatory; participating contractor submits pre- and post-installation applications; cheque by mail within 60 days of post-install approval. Owner must apply; detached, semi, row, townhome or mobile home on permanent foundation; new builds (occupied 6 months or less) not eligible; Cornwall Electric customers not eligible unless heating with Enbridge gas. Gas-home ground source is $3,000.

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings windows and doors (assessment stream)
facts.claim: $100 per rough opening for each window, door, skylight or sliding door replaced with an ENERGY STAR certified model. Rebate is per rough opening, not per unit. A minimum of three window rough openings, or one door, skylight or sliding door rough opening, counts as one qualified measure; two windows alone earn nothing. Complete frame replacement only (glass, sash or door slab alone is not eligible). Professional installer; keep ENERGY STAR labels until the post-audit.
facts.eligibility: Owner of a single detached, semi-detached, row or townhome or mobile home on a permanent foundation, 6 months of occupancy, heated mainly by Enbridge gas, electricity, oil, propane or wood
facts.notes: Read the Nov 2025 eligibility PDF 2026-10-03. Triplexes, duplexes and stacked townhomes are not eligible; a house with a later-added secondary suite is.

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings assessment stream rules
facts.claim: Pre-audit before any work, at least two qualified measures, post-audit within 180 days of the pre-audit or by December 31, 2026, whichever is first, with post-audits scheduled in the tracking system by November 30, 2026. $600 audit rebate; $500 extra for three or more upgrades. Total cap $5,000 for Enbridge gas-heated homes and $10,000 for homes heated by electricity, oil, propane or wood. No double-dipping with earlier HER or HER+ rebates.
facts.eligibility: Registered energy advisor at an authorized service organization; Cornwall Electric customers excluded unless converting to or from Enbridge gas
facts.dates: Post-audit by Dec 31, 2026; scheduled by Nov 30, 2026
facts.notes: Whether the stream continues in 2027 is not stated in the Nov 2025 document. Re-check before quoting dates after 2026.

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings attic stream (no assessment)
facts.claim: Rebate is 50% of the total attic insulation cost after tax, up to $1,250 for an attic (from R-12 or less to R-50 pays $1,250; over R-12 to R-25 pays $1,000; over R-25 to R-35 pays $800) and up to $750 for a cathedral ceiling or flat roof (R-12 or less to R-20 pays $650; up to R-25 to R-28 pays $750). Insulate 100% of the roof assembly. A participating insulation contractor must do the work. Pre-register at homerenovationsavings.ca and have an in-home visit before work starts. Installation done by November 30, 2026 and entered in the tracking system by December 31, 2026.
facts.amount: up to $1,250 attic / $750 cathedral or flat roof
facts.eligibility: Owner of a single detached, semi-detached, row or townhome or mobile home on a permanent foundation; six months of occupancy; Enbridge gas, electricity, oil, propane or wood heat
facts.dates: Requirements version January 2026; install by Nov 30, 2026
facts.notes: Read 2026-10-03. Triplexes, duplexes, low-rise apartments and stacked townhomes excluded; a house built as a single dwelling with a later secondary suite is eligible.

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings assessment stream insulation amounts
facts.claim: Attic to at least R-50, minimum 50% of the roof assembly, pro-rated by area: $1,500 from R-12 or less, $1,200 from R-12 to R-25, $900 from R-25 to R-35; cathedral ceiling or flat roof $780; total roof assembly capped at $1,500 and one measure. Exterior walls (min 20% of wall area, pro-rated): $1,200 for R-7.5 to R-12 added, $2,100 for over R-12 to R-20, $3,600 for over R-20. Basement walls (min 20%): $900 for R-10 to R-22, $1,500 over R-22; foundation header $300 (needs wall work too); basement slab $500; basement wall plus header up to $1,800; wall plus slab up to $2,000; all three up to $2,300. Crawl space walls $600 or $1,200; crawl space ceiling $1,200; basement plus crawl space wall max $1,500; crawl space combinations up to $2,700. Exposed floor $300 for at least R-20 over at least 11 square metres. Semi-detached and end-unit row homes get 75% of the maximum, middle-unit rows 50%. Air sealing $200 or $250 if 10% above the base target.
facts.eligibility: Assessment stream: pre-audit, at least two qualified measures, post-audit by Dec 31, 2026; professional contractor
facts.notes: Read 2026-10-03. Insulation measures count toward the two-measure minimum as stated in the PDF (for example basement wall plus slab counts as two).

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings heat pump stream rules
facts.claim: Rebates: cold-climate air-source heat pump $1,250 per ton up to $7,500 for homes heated by electric resistance, oil, propane or wood, and $500 per ton up to $2,000 for Enbridge gas homes or any rented unit; ground-source $2,000 per ton up to $12,000, or a flat $3,000 for gas homes and rentals. Tons are rated heating capacity at 8.3C (12,000 BTU/h per ton). One rebate per home; up to three outdoor units count toward it. For electric, oil and wood homes only NRCan sizing options C and D qualify; oil homes must remove or empty the tank with a TSSA contractor. Homes that already have a heat pump for space heating are not eligible. Must be on the NRCan cold-climate list (HSPF2 6.6 Region V, SEER2 15.2, COP 1.8 at -15C, 70% capacity maintenance), installed by a participating HVAC contractor after written pre-approval, with the contractor filing the post-installation application within 30 days. Cheque by mail within 60 days. Existing electric-resistance or wood heat may stay as backup.
facts.eligibility: Owner of a single detached, semi-detached, row, townhome or mobile home on a permanent foundation; the requirements document also allows an individual unit in a stacked townhome, duplex or triplex with its own heating and meter; six months of occupancy
facts.dates: Requirements version May 2025; no end date stated in the document
facts.notes: Read 2026-10-03 together with the program's heat pump page. The page lists only the narrower house types; the requirements PDF is broader, so tell readers to confirm with the program.
